name: Hone
quote: The launch configuration can run up to 16 one-CPU, 256 MiB grading containers at once. A 16-vCPU, 16-GiB host is recommended
notes: CPU-only by design: README sizes the validator grading host in CPU/RAM terms and the reference demo miner just calls an external LLM API; no GPU mentioned anywhere in repo.

name: Data Universe
quote: Miners do not require a GPU and should be able to run on a low-tier machine, as long as it has sufficient network bandwidth and disk space.
notes: Explicit CPU-only miner statement; validator doc adds 'at least 32 GB of RAM but do not require a GPU'.

name: Desearch
quote: min_cores: 2 # Minimum number of CPU cores ... min_ram: 8 # Minimum RAM (GB)
notes: Official min_compute.yml v1.0.4 miner compute_spec (2 cores/8GB RAM/SSD/Ubuntu 24.04) contains no gpu key at all; search-API relay subnet.

name: Orion
notes: README confirms a local miner GPU ('Quasar-Preview ... runs locally on the miner GPU', --devices 0) but no GPU model or VRAM figure is documented in repo or the linked HF model card.

name: Score
notes: From the open-source example miner's Chutes NodeSelector config (excludes 5090/b200/h200/h20/mi300x); MINER.md itself only says 'Have GPU/cloud capacity for inference'.

name: RedTeam
quote: System Requirements: CPU: 2+ cores, RAM: 8GB+, Storage: 50GB+, OS: Linux-based (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS+ recommended)
notes: Miner prerequisites list CPU/RAM/storage/OS only; no GPU appears anywhere in repo docs (validators: 8+ cores, 32GB+, 512GB+ storage).

name: Herald
quote: **No GPU / no ML** — it is network-I/O bound
notes: Validator guide hardware table lists GPU: none; root min_compute.yml miner spec is 2 CPU / 4 GB RAM with no GPU; miners are article contributors via the Herald website.

name: Liquidity
notes: TypeScript tooling around a hosted weights server (77.creativebuilds.io); validators only fetch/push weights and the repo documents no hardware requirements.

name: Bitcast
notes: Miners are YouTube creators serving OAuth tokens via an axon; repo (README, AGENTS.md) documents no miner/validator hardware or GPU specs.

name: Capcomp
quote: A miner can do useful work with nothing but a CPU ... needs a GPU that fits Qwen3-8B in bf16
notes: Official repo (found via org page). min_compute.yml v2.0.0: miner GPU optional (min_vram 32 / rec 48, compute cap 8.0) for local evaluation; validator requires 4x 32GB (rec 8x 48GB).

name: MoirAI
notes: Repo contains only a product-overview README plus images (no miner setup, no min_compute.yml); web search surfaced no official hardware docs.

name: sundae_bar
notes: Miners submit SKILL.md files via the sundae_bar Lab and evaluation runs on the subnet's hosted harness; repo README and sundaebar.ai page document no miner hardware.
